heading: Meet Itasca
body:
This is demo content. **Itasca** is the imaginary teardrop trailer used to show off this template.

Replace this page with your own trailer's story — how you found her, what you love about her, where she came from. You can write in [Markdown](https://www.markdownguide.org/basic-syntax/): **bold**, *italic*, [links](https://example.com), and lists all work.

Edit everything here through the visual editor at `/admin`, or by editing `src/content/about.json` directly. The spec sheet on the right and the gallery below are optional — fill them in or remove them.

gallery.caption: A placeholder photo — swap in your own.
Add as many as you like.
